source: Netball Skills and Conditioning Manual, Level 1, 3rd version, Niel du Plessis and Erin Burger
notes: Not a catch. The ball is controlled beside the head and sent on across the body, so the athlete has it for a fifth of the drill and then it is in flight again.
readyNote: Hands up beside the head, which is where the manual tells the passer to put the ball. Aiming the waiting hands at a passer two metres away instead left them at her waist.
